issues.problem: The printed token ends ...dhararamatiḥ, i.e. adardhar + aramatiḥ. A visarga form adardhaḥ before a- would be adardho 'ramatiḥ, so the verb must end in r: adardhar, 3 sg. imperfect of the intensive of √dhṛ (dardharti). The split word does not match the printed text.

The digit 1 is indeed the svarita mark, but the suggestion 'vyṛtūnadardhararamatiḥ' silently undoes the sandhi (ṛtūm̐r + adardhar is the printed form). Suggest 'vyṛtū~radardhararamatiḥ' (digit removed only).
jyeṣṭha is 'foremost/eldest' (English 'foremost'); 'श्रेष्ठ' means best, a different sense.

'n. acc. pl.' is not a possible form of apas (n.) 'work' (acc. pl. apāṃsi; apaḥ is acc. sg.), and the translation 'all altered works' pairs it with vikṛtam (sg.) and śaśvān (m. pl.). Alternatively apaḥ is f. acc. pl. 'waters', which the notes mention. The agreement is unresolved; label 'acc. (n. sg. 'work' or f. pl. 'waters')' and lower confidence in the 'works' reading. No patch.
issues.fix: gram: acc. sg. n. (apas 'work') or f. acc. pl. (ap 'waters')
